saveTheDate.heading: Save the date
saveTheDate.description: A public link that announces the date before the invitations go out. It shows title, date, place and your note, never the address or names. Good for a group chat.
saveTheDate.noteDescription: For example “The invitation follows in spring”. At most {{ max }} characters.
saveTheDate.copyFailed: The link could not be copied
saveTheDate.shareText: Save the date: {{ title }} on {{ date }}
saveTheDate.shareFailed: The link could not be shared
saveTheDate.openNamed: View: save-the-date page, opens in a new tab
saveTheDate.renewDescription: The current link stops working, also in chats it was posted to.
saveTheDate.disableDescription: The link then shows “Not found”. The note is deleted.
saveTheDate.pastOff: After the event, save the date cannot be turned on any more.
saveTheDate.failed: Save the date could not be changed
saveTheDate.conflict: The event is over. Save the date can only be turned off.

photoStand.heading: Photo stand
photoStand.description: One shared upload page for all guests, reached through a card with a QR code on the tables or at the entrance. For events without fixed seats, otherwise there are the place cards.
photoStand.copyFailed: The link could not be copied
photoStand.openNamed: View: upload page of the photo stand, opens in a new tab
photoStand.renewHeading: New link for the photo stand?
photoStand.renewDescription: The current link and a card printed already stop working. The photos stay.
photoStand.disableDescription: The upload page then shows “Invalid link”. Photos uploaded already stay.
photoStand.pastOff: After the event, the photo stand cannot be turned on any more.
photoStand.failed: The photo stand could not be changed
photoStand.conflict: The event is over or uploads have ended. The photo stand can only be turned off.
